svg.title: Corner Fortresses: a map for 4 kings and their peasants
svg.desc: Four kings, each on a raised fortress yard in a corner behind earth ramparts, reached by a ramp through the gate facing the middle and by bots-only zigzags up the two walls. All twelve peasants live in the middle, round the market, each team's three nearest its king. Acid lakes part the fortresses.
svg.text: 4 kings, 3 peasants each · 24 × 24 map (12288 game units square) · 4 teams of 4, 16 players
Four kings, each on a raised fortress yard in a corner behind earth ramparts, reached by a ramp through
the gate facing the middle and by bots-only zigzags up the two walls. All twelve peasants live in the
middle, round the market, each team's three nearest its king. Acid lakes part the fortresses.
Heights: fields 240 · the middle 210 to 180 · the market 220 · fortress yards 330, ramparts 90 higher · acid lakes 60 deep
Ground: cracked concrete and rust-stained gravel, oil-dark ground round the fortresses, a paved
Plants: none, apart from orangemushrooms in damp corners of the fortress yards.
Features: pipesarray1, pipesarray2 and pipeslong1 to pipeslong3 along the fortress walls; crateblue,
crateorange, cratered, cranetruck1, minitruck1 and minitruck2 in the market; armnanotc_dead and
Sky and weather: brown smog sky, yellow haze; wind 4 to 14; tidal 10; the acid lakes hurt anything
in them (water.damage 60, to tune in play).
Each quarter is the same, turned 90° about the centre. Heights in game units; lighter ground stands higher.
